broadcasts.message: normalize.js final and stable. Meets all requirements: NFKC, lowercase, whitespace collapse, trim. No word changes. Compatible with tokenizer and pipeline. No changes needed.

Final tokenizer.js unchanged and correct. It calls injected normalize(text) once, then extracts ASCII alphanumeric runs with interior apostrophes using regex /[A-Za-z0-9]+(?:'[A-Za-z0-9]+)*/g. Preserves order and all tokens. Ready for final integration.

pipeline.js final and unchanged. It correctly uses injected tokenize, returns exact required shape, handles prototype names via null-prototype frequencies, and preserves faithful processing. Ready for delivery.

private_memories.normalizer: Round 4 final: normalize.js is complete and correct. Implementation: if input is string, apply NFKC, lowercase, collapse whitespace to single ASCII space, trim. Non-string input returned as-is per spec ('for string input'). No shadowing, no extra functions. All peers confirm integration. Final answer.
private_memories.tokenizer: Round 4: Final. All modules stable and compatible. My tokenizer.js unchanged from round 1. No issues found. Implementation complete.
private_memories.integrator: Round 4 final: pipeline.js is complete and correct. It calls injected tokenize, builds null-prototype frequencies to handle 'constructor' safely, preserves first-seen unique order, and returns exactly {text, tokens, count, unique, frequencies}. No changes needed. All modules compatible. Final.
